text:
maya: Quick heads-up — noticed a bunch of recontacted trial accounts after playbook run yesterday. looks like suppression window didn't apply.
jordan: oh no. which playbook?
maya: the "onboard-quickstart" automation that fires welcome + 3-day checkin. we should be suppressing accounts with "recontacted_recently" tag for 14 days.
leo: I saw duplicate webhook deliveries too. maybe webhook fired a re-enqueue.
maya: I pulled the raw logs: cs-playbook-service returned 200, but the event payload had user.last_contact_at missing. snippet:
```
{ "account_id": 789, "event": "welcome_sent", "last_contact_at": null }
```
sophia: Sounds like a CRM sync backfill removed last_contact_at for accounts with legacy contact records.
jordan: Can we patch the playbook to use our fallback: crm.contact_history_lookup(account_id) || account.created_at ?
maya: yes — propose we:
- add fallback in playbook action
- add a dedupe guard: if tag recontacted_recently present, skip
- run one-off backfill to repopulate last_contact_at from contact_history where available
leo: Timeline?
maya: can do patch in staging today, deploy tomorrow AM, run backfill on Thursday at 2am PST (low traffic)
sophia: Also recommend adding a metric to console: "playbook_recontacted_count" and an alert when > 5/hr.
jordan: agree. And add a QA step for enablement: have CS enablement review the 10 sample accounts before backfill.
maya: tagging @enablement for review — @enablement can you take 10 sample accounts from the "recontact-samples" saved view?
enablement: got it, will review by EOD. will flag any risky renewals separately.
cs-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for branch maya/playbook-fallback — build passed :thumbsup:
maya: thanks. the backfill SQL I'll run:
```
UPDATE accounts a
SET last_contact_at = ch.last_seen
FROM contact_history ch
WHERE ch.account_id = a.id AND a.last_contact_at IS NULL;
```
leo: make sure you run with batch 10k and a dry-run first.
maya: will do dry-run, then 10k batches. will post results here.
sophia: also add to playbook: if renewal_risk_score >= 0.7, do manual CS review instead of automated recontact.
jordan: good call.
maya: ok moving forward. I'll create the PR and schedule the backfill. will update thread with PR link and sampling results.
enablement: noted, will confirm samples and add feedback summary.
